patterns.note: Full-bleed hero image with overlaid text and graphic elements, transitioning into distinct content sections that utilize a mix of grid layouts for projects and three-column layouts for services.

Dramatic use of oversized, bold sans-serif typography for section headings and a massive, decorative sans-serif for the footer, contrasted with an elegant serif for the hero's sub-heading and smaller, uppercase sans-serif labels.
A high-contrast palette of black and white is accented by a vibrant, warm yellow/orange, particularly in the hero section, and occasional bright blues or pinks within imagery.

The hero features a subtle parallax zoom on the background image, while the main hero text and a keyhole graphic scale up and fade in. As the user scrolls, sections and content cards (projects, services) reveal themselves with staggered fade-up and slide-in animations. The navigation bar remains sticky, changing from transparent to a solid white background upon scroll.
Major content sections are clearly delineated by large, bold typographic titles that often slide in from the side, creating strong visual breaks and guiding the user through the page.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a full-bleed image with a subtle parallax effect, where the background image zooms and shifts slightly as the user scrolls. Overlaid text and graphic elements are revealed with scaling and fading animations, creating a dynamic introduction. This likely leverages WebGL or Canvas for the background and GSAP for the text/graphic animations.

Scroll-triggered animations, likely powered by GSAP ScrollTrigger, are used extensively to reveal content. As sections enter the viewport, their titles slide in from the left, and individual content cards (e.g., project images, service descriptions) animate into view with staggered fade-up or slide-in transitions.

The primary navigation bar at the top of the page is sticky. Initially, it has a transparent background, allowing the hero image to show through. Upon scrolling past the hero, it transitions to a solid white background with a subtle border, maintaining readability and accessibility throughout the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body) and an even larger decorative sans-serif for the footer, paired with an elegant, medium-sized serif for the hero's sub-heading and small uppercase sans-serif labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle for buttons and navigation items (e.g., 4-8px), sharp for most image corners, with a pill shape for the primary call-to-action button.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, especially in the hero and between major content sections, creating a sense of grandeur and allowing elements to breathe. Content within sections is more balanced.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its dramatic, full-bleed hero image with a dynamic parallax and text reveal, combined with the bold and impactful use of massive typography as both section dividers and a striking, almost sculptural footer element. This creates a highly memorable and artistic visual experience.
